label: LOCAL DOCKER EMULATION of the recommended Fargate task (1 vCPU / 3 GiB). Not a Fargate, ECR, ALB or cloud result. No AWS access, credentials, resources or spending.

host.oneVcpuEmulation: every container pinned to cpuset 0 (Compose cannot enforce a task-wide CPU quota)
host.storage: Docker named volumes on the WSL2 ext4 disk (not a Windows bind mount)

buildSeconds.note: docker load of the gzip archive restored the identical image ID; an unpack time, not a registry pull

hashAndIntegrityCost.attribution: PRAGMA integrity_check runs in the verifier and again in the API (about 424 s of the 658-717 s cold start); init's double hash of all 3.95 GB took 15 s. Repeated SHA-256 is not the dominant cost on native disk; the earlier ~11 min per full hash came from the Windows share.

logSentinels.scope: U6 holds for these requests and log levels; not proof for every MOTIS/Photon code path

passed, 10/10 journeys, warning 'Source freshness is aging'
first poll after the pause: /readyz 503 ENGINE_TIMEOUT (1.2 s) and journeys 504 ENGINE_TIMEOUT; recovered 0.6 s after unpause

failureSimulations.case: address provider down (docker stop photon for 43 s)
failureSimulations.observed: /readyz stayed 200 and journeys 200; /v1/places?type=address returned 503 CATEGORY_UNAVAILABLE; restored after restart. On ECS Photon is essential, so its exit stops the task
not emulated: in Compose the API shares MOTIS's network namespace, so stopping MOTIS removes the API listener; on Fargate the namespace belongs to the task

assumptions.U2: CONFIRMED locally: MOTIS image default user uid 100; runs as 10001 with scratch chowned by init; wget and sh present. Temurin image has curl; Photon runs as 10001
assumptions.U3: CONFIRMED locally: MOTIS reads its listener from /generation/motis/config.yml (0.0.0.0:8080; n_threads=1 under the one-core pin). It listens on all task interfaces, so the task security group is what keeps 8080 private

diskHighWater.note: Arithmetic from measured image and volume sizes; Fargate's own reservation and pull staging are unmeasured. Each task has its own 20 GiB, so rollout overlap adds no disk.

utilization.motis: high-water 819 MiB incl. page cache (64%); RSS 354 MiB
utilization.api: high-water 512 MiB (100%: reclaimable SQLite page cache, failcnt 0); RSS 218 MiB; docker-stats peak 348 MiB (68%)

twoTaskOverlapGiB.note: 2 x one task's high-water, not two tasks run together; ALB memory is unmeasurable

budget.verdict: 1 vCPU / 3 GiB holds locally: no container above 85% of its limit except the API's reclaimable page cache; no OOM; no 4 GiB step indicated.
budget.fallbackRisk: The no-addresses 0.5 vCPU / 2 GiB variant gives the verifier 128 MiB; it peaked at 120 MiB (94%) here with the composite generation. The integrity-check-bound startup would roughly double at 0.5 vCPU (estimate, not measured).

draftFixes: stage_bundle: stage zero-byte graph files (run-01 failure)
service.json healthCheckGracePeriodSeconds 600 -> 1200 (measured 658-717 s to /readyz 200; ECS applies the grace to ALB and container health checks)
api health check startPeriod 30 -> 300 (ECS maximum), interval 10 -> 30, retries 3 -> 10 (tolerates 600 s; lifespan 274-338 s)
motis health check retries 12 -> 10 at 15 s and photon retries 18 -> 9 at 20 s (ECS allows at most 10 retries; windows 210 s and 300 s)
validate_drafts: enforce ECS health-check bounds, the API startup tolerance and the grace floor
operatorNote: The first data-image build grew Docker Desktop's non-sparse WSL2 disk (on C:) by 7.9 GB (about 4 GB of build context plus 4 GB of layers); freeing space inside Docker does not shrink it. Builders need at least ~10 GB free on the Docker disk.
